# JSZip 3.10.1

Vendored from the historical Bundlr Bun implementation. The distribution is
JSZip 3.10.1, used for Windows launchers and classic ZIP client archives.

Upstream: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/tree/v3.10.1

`LICENSE.markdown` preserves the upstream notices. Bundlr uses the MIT option
of JSZip's dual licence. The bundled pako notices are retained in the distribution.
